scope: Reproduced selected-record review queue, not publication decisions, live pages or indexed counts. Flags overlap. Equal numerical histories do not establish semantic equivalence; historical coverage does not establish issuer inactivity.

rules.historical: Latest reporting end is earlier than capture date minus two calendar years; independently checked for each unit.
rules.equal_vector: Same company; all selected kind/unit/start/end/value tuples match after sorting. Filing date and accession are intentionally excluded.
rules.constant: Every unit has one distinct numerical value across all selected observations.
rules.unflagged: No flags under these narrow checks; not editorial approval or complete quality assurance.
